options.name: name
options.description: A module name, used with "enabled" to enabled disabled module

options.name: path
options.description: A local module filename, used with "enabled" to install a module

options.name: priority
options.description: SELinux module priority, 0 means SELinux store default (400) with "path" and "enabled", otherwise all priorities

options.name: state
options.description: Desired module state enabled - install a module file with `path`, enable a module with `name` disabled - disable module absent - remove module

options.name: store
options.description: Use other than current SELinux module store, e.g. mls, minimum, refpolicy ...
